name: AlphaFold Protein Structure Database

version.value: Model version 6 (P04637 model created 2025-08-01); human proteome UP000005640_9606_HUMAN_v6.tar 5.18 GB

scope: Predicted structures with per-residue confidence (pLDDT) for UniProt proteins; proteome bundles on FTP.
mapping_methods: Residue numbering follows UniProt canonical sequence.

quantitative.summary: pLDDT 0-100 per residue; predicted aligned error.

licence.name: CC BY 4.0, academic and commercial use (FAQ)

coverage_limitations: Predicted, not experimental; low confidence in disordered regions and for complexes/ligands
known_omissions: The browser downloads page denied automated access; API and FTP were used instead

reuse_decision.rationale: Per-protein retrieval for the UniProt proteins our MaveDB score sets are about (models, per-residue pLDDT and prediction metadata through the API); the 5.18 GB human proteome bundle is not needed for that set.

status.notes: API returns model metadata; per-protein files for the MaveDB proteins are fetched by acquisition/fetch_per_protein.py.

evidence_profile.biological_context: Single-chain structure models of UniProt reference sequences. Ligands, binding partners, membranes, modifications and alternative conformations are not modelled.
evidence_profile.evidence_strength: Computational model. Per-residue confidence (pLDDT) is the only uncertainty provided and measures confidence of the model, not experimental support.
evidence_profile.mechanistic_confidence: Low on its own. A model can place a residue in a buried, exposed or interface-like environment; it cannot show that a substitution changes stability, binding or activity.
evidence_profile.phenotype_implication: None. Supports reasoning about missense and in-frame changes only in combination with experimental structures, domain annotation and variant-level assays.
evidence_profile.absence_means: A protein or isoform without a model, or a low-confidence region, has no usable structural context here; this is not evidence of disorder or of the lack of a structure.

overlaps_with_sources.note: predicted models versus experimentally determined structures: compare, never merge
